forms.ex: Ich suche eine Wohnung in der Stadt.
forms.exEn: I'm looking for a flat in town.

forms.en: search; looking for (a flat, a job)
forms.ex: Die Suche nach dem Kind hat die ganze Nacht gedauert.
forms.exEn: The search for the child went on all night.

forms.clue: the flat hunt (looking for a home)
forms.ex: Die Wohnungssuche in der Großstadt kann Monate dauern.
forms.exEn: Looking for a flat in a big city can take months.

forms.ex: Ich benutze jeden Tag eine Suchmaschine.
forms.exEn: I use a search engine every day.

forms.en: visit (a person, a place); attend (a course)
forms.why: be- points the verb at someone: you seek a person out where they are.
forms.ex: Ich besuche am Wochenende meine Eltern.
forms.exEn: I'm visiting my parents at the weekend.

forms.ex: Am Wochenende bekommen wir Besuch.
forms.exEn: We're having visitors at the weekend.

forms.clue: the visitor (to a museum, a website)
forms.ex: Das Museum hat jedes Jahr viele Besucher.
forms.exEn: The museum has a lot of visitors every year.

forms.why: Learn it as a word: ver- adds no clear picture here; it once meant to put something to the test.
forms.ex: Ich versuche es morgen noch einmal.
forms.exEn: I'll try again tomorrow.

forms.ex: Beim zweiten Versuch hat sie die Prüfung bestanden.
forms.exEn: She passed the exam at the second attempt.

forms.ex: Viele Menschen sind gegen Tierversuche.
forms.exEn: Many people are against animal testing.

forms.why: versuchen once also meant to tempt, to put someone to the test: the thing that tests you.
forms.ex: Ich konnte der Versuchung nicht widerstehen.
forms.exEn: I couldn't resist the temptation.

forms.why: unter = under: you search below the surface.
forms.ex: Der Arzt untersucht das Kind.
forms.exEn: The doctor is examining the child.

forms.ex: Morgen habe ich eine Untersuchung beim Arzt.
forms.exEn: Tomorrow I have a check-up at the doctor's.

forms.en: go to see (a doctor); seek out (a place)
forms.clue: to go and see (a doctor, an office)
forms.why: auf = up, open: you go up to a person or a place on purpose.
forms.ex: Bei starken Schmerzen sollten Sie einen Arzt aufsuchen.
forms.exEn: If the pain is bad, you should see a doctor.

forms.why: aus = out: you look through many and take one out.
forms.ex: Wir suchen zusammen ein Geschenk für Oma aus.
forms.exEn: We're choosing a present for Grandma together.

forms.en: look out, dig out (a document, a number)
forms.clue: to dig out (an address, a document)
forms.why: heraus = out: you search a pile and bring one thing out.
forms.ex: Ich suche dir die Adresse schnell heraus.
forms.exEn: I'll quickly dig out the address for you.

forms.clue: to scan, to search over (the sky, the ground)
forms.why: ab = off, all over: you go over every part of an area.
forms.ex: Mit dem Fernglas sucht er den Horizont ab.
forms.exEn: He scans the horizon with his binoculars.

forms.en: search (a flat, a bag, a file)
forms.why: durch = through: you go through everything in it.
forms.ex: Die Polizei hat die Wohnung durchsucht.
forms.exEn: The police searched the flat.

forms.ex: Bei der Durchsuchung hat die Polizei Drogen gefunden.
forms.exEn: The police found drugs during the search.

forms.why: er- = reaching a goal: you seek to obtain something.
forms.ex: Die Behörde ersucht alle Bürger um Mithilfe.
forms.exEn: The authorities are asking all citizens for help.

forms.why: Learn it as a word: the ge- noun of suchen, a request in writing.
forms.note: das Gesuch: neuter, unlike der Besuch and der Versuch. Learn the article with the word.
forms.ex: Das Gericht hat sein Gesuch abgelehnt.
forms.exEn: The court rejected his request.

forms.clue: to gather up (from all over the place)
forms.why: zusammen = together: you search and bring things together.
forms.ex: Ich muss meine Sachen noch zusammensuchen.
forms.exEn: I still have to gather my things together.
